policy: A freeze file is written once and never edited. Every later change is recorded here with the field, the reason and both SHA256 values, and every batch manifest records the freeze file's own SHA256 so an after-the-fact edit is detectable from the batch alone.

amendments.note: The v11 freeze itself was not edited. Three family-helper files were repaired after it was written, because the first paid attempt aborted on a helper reference (the batch produced no rows). The freeze's recorded hashes for those three files therefore differ from the working tree; the batch ran with the repaired helpers, and the manifest's freeze_sha256 proves the freeze file itself is byte-identical to what was frozen.
